title: Morph Target Face Expression Blender with Time Control
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a morph target face expression blender with full timeline control. Requirements:

## Scene Setup
- Dark gradient background (top: #1a1a2e, bottom: #16213e).
- A 3D head/face mesh created procedurally using a SphereGeometry(2, 64, 64) as the base. Define 4 morph targets by displacing vertices:
  - 'smile': raise vertices near mouth corners upward, widen mouth area.
  - 'surprise': open mouth wide (lower jaw vertices down), raise brow vertices up.
  - 'anger': lower brow vertices, compress mouth vertices together, slight forward push on brow ridge.
  - 'sadness': droop mouth corners down, raise inner brow vertices slightly.
- Each morph target influence ranges from 0.0 to 1.0.
- Use MeshStandardMaterial with color #e8beac (skin tone), roughness 0.6, metalness 0.1.
- Add two eyes using small dark sphere meshes positioned on the face.
- Ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light from upper-right (intensity 0.8).
- Camera at position (0, 0, 6), looking at origin. OrbitControls enabled.

## Expression Blender UI (DOM)
- A panel on the left side (width 280px, semi-transparent dark background) titled 'Expression Blender'.
- Four labeled sliders (HTML range inputs), one per expression: 'smile', 'surprise', 'anger', 'sadness'. Each slider ranges 0-100 (maps to 0.0-1.0 morph influence). Default all at 0.
- A 'Normalize' checkbox. When checked, all morph influences are automatically normalized so they sum to 1.0 (proportionally scaled). When unchecked, raw values are used (can exceed 1.0 total).
- A 'Reset All' button that sets all sliders to 0.

## Timeline System
- Below the 3D viewport, render a timeline bar (height 80px, full width).
- The timeline spans 0 to 10 seconds. Show tick marks every 1 second.
- A playhead (vertical red line) indicates current time. It can be dragged left/right.
- A 'Play/Pause' button (▶/❜❜ toggle), a 'Stop' button (resets to t=0), and a speed selector dropdown with options: 0.25x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x.
- Default speed is 1x. Default state is paused at t=0.

## Keyframe System
- A 'Set Keyframe' button (with a diamond ◆ icon) that records the current slider values at the current playhead time.
- Keyframes appear as small diamond markers on the timeline bar.
- When playing, the system interpolates (linear) between keyframes to animate morph targets.
- If no keyframes exist, morphs stay at current slider values.
- A 'Clear Keyframes' button removes all keyframes.
- Support at least 10 keyframes.

## Undo/Redo
- Implement undo (Ctrl+Z) and redo (Ctrl+Y) for slider changes and keyframe additions/removals.
- Maintain a history stack of up to 20 states.

## Keyboard Shortcuts
- Spacebar: toggle play/pause.
- 'R' key: reset all sliders to 0.
- 'K' key: set keyframe at current time.
- Left/Right arrow keys: move playhead by 0.5 seconds.
- Ctrl+Z: undo, Ctrl+Y: redo.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- morphInfluences: {smile: number, surprise: number, anger: number, sadness: number} — current morph target values (0.0-1.0 each).
- normalizeEnabled: boolean — whether normalize checkbox is checked.
- timelineTime: number — current playhead time in seconds (0-10).
- isPlaying: boolean — whether timeline is playing.
- playbackSpeed: number — current speed multiplier.
- keyframes: array of {time: number, morphs: {smile, surprise, anger, sadness}} sorted by time.
- keyframeCount: number — total keyframes.
- undoStackSize: number — current undo history length.
- redoStackSize: number — current redo history length.
- totalMorphWeight: number — sum of all 4 morph influences.
- meshVertexCount: number — vertex count of the face mesh.
- lastAction: string — last action performed (e.g., 'slider_change', 'set_keyframe', 'clear_keyframes', 'undo', 'redo', 'reset', 'play', 'pause', 'stop', 'seek').

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Morph influences must each be clamped to [0.0, 1.0]. When normalize is enabled, the sum of all morph influences must equal exactly 1.0 (or 0.0 if all sliders are at 0). Timeline time must be clamped to [0, 10]. Keyframe interpolation must be linear and produce NaN-free results. Undo/redo must perfectly restore previous states.
